_comment: Showcase #8: the ~1 km2 FMG-compiled streamed world (world.setTerrainSource kind:map, camera-following client stream) with the two whole-GLB burgs placed at the IR anchors (Highkeep manor, Fisherton cottage). Aerial over the main island, distance dissolving into the fog band. streamFollow carries no valid regionId on purpose — it only nudges the client stream radius (schema caps at 8); the live client streams around the camera regardless.
